notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]New developments:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [u]Voice-overs:[/u] voice overs have been developed. Now you can listen to your favorite characters talk instead of just reading their conversations.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Controller support:[/u] with the new update we added controller support so you can use your favorite controller to follow along the Blaze brothers story.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bugs fixed:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [u]Stuck in Chapter 6:[/u] we fixed a bug that stopped players from progressing in the story-line in Chapter 6.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Achievements:[/u] we fixed a bug that prevented reaching some of the steam achievements of the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Game version:[/u] the game version in the main menu has been update.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Localization:[/u] some grammar issues in the dialog have been fixed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Music restart:[/u] there was a bug that restarted the music every time a dialog appeared, with this fix now you can listen to the whole music track.
[/list]
[h3][b]Extra:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [u]Store page:[/u] the system requirements in the steam store page have been updated to be more accurate to what systems can run our game.
[/list]
